login.description: Sign in as a tenant developer. You will be redirected to the Cognito Hosted UI.

home.header_description: TenkaCloud Battle / Challenge — Tenant admin console
home.tenant_name_missing_header: Tenant name is missing from your JWT
home.tenant_name_missing_body: Sign out and sign back in. If the issue persists, ask the System Admin to set the custom:tenantName attribute on your Cognito user.

event_list.description: Competition events. One event = N teams x M problems that can be deployed and torn down in bulk.
event_list.empty_no_event: No events yet. Start by clicking "Create event".
event_list.empty_all_archived: No events match. Tick the checkbox above to include archived ones.
event_list.archive_modal_body: Archiving event {name} removes it from the default view.
event_list.archive_modal_note: You cannot un-archive, but child deployment / Team rows are auto-removed by TTL. Run Bulk Teardown first if you haven't.
event_list.archive_conflict_known: Event "{name}" cannot be archived (current: {current}, allowed: DRAFT / ENDED / TEARDOWN)

saml_sso.description: Federate your company's IdP (Entra ID / Okta / Google Workspace, etc.) with this tenant's Cognito UserPool via SAML 2.0. After saving, sign-in flows through your corporate SSO.
saml_sso.pooled_warning_body: If this tenant is in pooled mode (= multiple tenants share a UserPool), changes here affect sign-in for all pooled tenants. silo (PLATINUM) tenants have an isolated UserPool.
saml_sso.platinum_only_body: SAML SSO is available only on PLATINUM tenants (= dedicated UserPool). Pooled tiers (BASIC / ADVANCED) share a UserPool, so SAML changes would affect other tenants. Upgrade to PLATINUM to enable SAML SSO.
saml_sso.platinum_only_description: SAML SSO configuration is available on PLATINUM tier.
saml_sso.field_metadata_url_desc: HTTPS URL that serves your IdP's federation metadata XML. Cert rotation is followed automatically.
saml_sso.field_provider_name_desc: Label shown on the Cognito Hosted UI sign-in button (alphanumeric + - _ , 3-32 chars).
saml_sso.field_enforce_desc: Turning this on disables username/password. A confirmation modal is shown before the flip.
saml_sso.save_success: SAML IdP applied to the Cognito UserPool. New sign-ins from now on use the SAML flow. Users already signed in are not affected.
saml_sso.delete_success: SAML disabled. Username/password path is restored, SAML button disappears from Hosted UI.
saml_sso.enforce_modal_body: Disables username/password and SRP, allowing sign-in only via SAML. Verify SAML sign-in in staging before flipping production.
saml_sso.enforce_modal_warning: If SAML is broken or the IdP cert rotation fails, nobody can sign in. As recovery, manually add COGNITO back to the UserPoolClient SupportedIdentityProviders in AWS Console.
saml_sso.delete_modal_body: Removes the SAML IdP and reverts the UserPoolClient to username/password. SAML sign-in stops working. Re-enable later by entering a Metadata URL.

users.description: Invite or remove administrators in this tenant. Invited users receive an email from Cognito with a temporary password.
users.empty: No users yet. Use "Invite user" to add one.
users.invite_modal_body: Cognito will send an email with a temporary password to the address. The user changes the password at first login.
users.invite_success: Invited {email}. The invitation email may take a few minutes to arrive.
users.field_email_desc: Recipient email. This becomes the username and cannot be changed later.
users.field_role_desc: ADR-020 / Issue #926 Phase B: pick one of 3 roles. Destructive routes stay TenantAdmin-only until Phase B.1 (per-route granular role check) lands; until then Operator / Viewer invites still get 403 on admin routes.
users.role_tenant_admin_desc: All destructive ops (user mgmt, SAML, delete, IAM mutate)
users.role_tenant_operator_desc: Can mutate (deploy, event progress, disruption fire). Cannot manage users.
users.delete_modal_body: Deletes {email}. The user can no longer sign in. You cannot delete yourself (lock-out prevention).
users.role_change_modal_body: Change the role of {email} (current: {current}) to the value selected below. The change takes effect immediately; the user will be authorised under the new role at next sign-in. You cannot change your own role (lock-out prevention).
